description_en: Queries the maximum limits and remaining quotas for URL refresh, directory refresh, prefetch, and blocking on the current day
description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshQuota查询当天URL刷新、目录刷新、预热及封禁的最大限制数量和剩余量
name: DescribeRefreshQuota

BlockQuota.description_en: The maximum number of blocking tasks on the current day

BlockRemain.description_en: The remaining number of blocking tasks on the current day

DirQuota.description_en: The maximum number of directory refresh tasks on the current day
DirQuota.description_zh: 当天目录刷新数量上限

DirRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余目录刷新数量

IgnoreParamsRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余忽略参数刷新数量

PreloadEdgeRemain.description_en: The remaining number of prefetch tasks for L1 nodes

PreloadQuota.description_en: The maximum number of prefetch tasks for L2 nodes on the current day
